name: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Parityakta Pension Yojana
benefit: to Be from a family living below the poverty line. to fulfill the basic needs of life. BenefitsPension Benefits : ₹ 600/- per month
eligibility_rules: The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. The Abandoned women aged between 18 to 59 years. The applicant should be living below the poverty line. The applicant name should be mentioned on the Samagr portal.
documents_required: Three photos of yourselfB.P.L. cardCertificate to confirm
how_to_apply: Mode: Online & OfflineStep 1 Go to the Samajik Suraksha portal.Step 2: Click on Samajik Suraksha pension avm arthik sahayata yojanaen.Step 3: Now click on the left on your screen Pension Yojana hetu online aavedan.Step 4: Fill in the required details and submit.
